_comment: Company categories the operator chose to target (configure for your own background). Names are matched case-insensitively against the company field. Add to these lists freely; that is the intended way to steer the search.
_not_corporate: Hard preference #3 in the 2026-08-15 calibration: 'not corporate', under ~100 people read as a CEILING not a target. The large_employers list is a penalty, not a filter — a genuinely great role at a big company still prints, it just stops leading the digest.

categories.label: creator-economy tools
categories.why: Their customers are audience-builders; a side content practice reads as a qualification rather than a conflict of interest.

categories.label: hospitality / luxury tech
categories.why: Matches the operator's prior hospitality background: domain knowledge of the job the software serves. | DISABLED 2026-10-08, operator's call: focus on future-proof industries rather than a hospitality search lane.

categories.label: AI evals / red-teaming / model QA
categories.why: Hires unusual backgrounds by design; agent-design and evals experience maps directly.

categories.label: LATAM / bilingual-premium
categories.why: Fully bilingual Spanish/English is an under-used asset: LATAM-facing roles pay a premium against less competition.

categories.label: AI implementation agency
categories.why: Portfolio over pedigree; the work is literally building and implementing solutions for other companies. Not enabled — these are mostly too small to have named boards, better found by search than by list.

categories.label: app-layer AI company
categories.why: Daily fluency with Claude/GPT is the qualification and most applicants are bluffing it. Not enabled as a NAME list — prefilter.ECOSYSTEM_SIGNALS already catches these by what the posting says.

categories.label: health / benefits tech
categories.why: Added 2026-10-08, operator's pick. Prior customer-support experience explaining health plans is domain knowledge here; paired with AI, few applicants match. Small and mid-size only; large carriers stay out under the not-corporate term.

categories.label: AI customer service
categories.why: Added 2026-10-08, operator's pick. Support is being rebuilt around AI agents; customer-support experience plus agent-building covers both sides.

categories.label: human-AI (voice, character, wellbeing)
categories.why: Added 2026-10-08: reading and steadying people is the operator's strongest people skill. Companies building AI that talks, emotes or supports wellbeing hire for exactly that plus AI fluency.

large_employers.why: Not a filter and no longer about headcount. On 2026-08-24 the operator relaxed hard term 3 ('under ~100 people'). What stays penalised is the shape the operator rejects - consultancies and body shops, banks, gig-work platforms, legacy enterprise IT, mega-tech and large health insurers. Big remote-first product companies were released.
large_employers._released_note: Anthropic and OpenAI were previously held at -3 to cancel the +3 prefilter.ECOSYSTEM_SIGNALS bonus for naming Claude. That cancellation was removed on purpose: the operator's Claude practice is the qualification, so those roles are meant to rise. Released 2026-08-24 with eyes open.
